name: Happy Gut Lab: 7 Steps to a Nourishing Salad
description:
**Copper + Cloves and Good Earth Presents...**

*Join us for another edition of Happy Gut Lab, where Chef Sarah, founder of* ***Copper + Cloves*** *and a passionate plant-based health coach, will take us through the art of building a salad that's as satisfying as it is nourishing!*

From choosing the right ingredients and balancing flavours to adding texture, colour and gut-friendly goodness, Sarah will share seven simple steps to help you put together salads that are anything but boring. The idea is to make healthy eating enjoyable, approachable and something you look forward to, rather than just another thing on your to-do list.

This time, we're also happy to partner with **Good Earth**, whose beautiful tableware, salad bowls, and serving pieces will bring the workshop to life and show how thoughtfully presented food can make everyday meals feel like an occasion!

**﻿After the workshop, we'll gather around the table for a shared lunch, with a thoughtfully prepared spread that puts everything we've explored into practice!**

name: Jahnavi
description:
Gentle, graceful, and full of force, the Ganga calls you to her banks.

This Bharatanatyam performance follows the river Ganga from Gangotri to Varanasi, bringing her changing moods to life through choreography, music, and visual design. What does it mean to travel a river as a pilgrim does, one verse at a time?

The performance evolved from the choreographer’s work on the official anthem for Namami Gange, the Government of India’s mission to rejuvenate the Ganga. Set predominantly to Sanskrit verses, the work treats the river as a thread connecting places, people, and generations.

name: Verse and Worse Karaoke with Aashish Paul
description:
**About the Event:**

Verse and Worse Karaoke with Aashish Paul - Dramatic duets, forgotten lyrics, guilty pleasure anthems - all welcome here. Hosted by Aashish Paul at The Humming Tree. No judgment, just good music and louder singalongs 😎

Join us this Tuesday!

**The Humming Tree:**

The Humming Tree - A grassroots performance venue in Bangalore, running from 2013 to 2019 and in the process becoming a cornerstone of Bangalore’s independent music, art, and cultural ecosystem.

Now, in 2026, The Humming Tree is back in a brand-new, purpose-designed space in Indiranagar. Built across 12,000 sq. ft., the venue features a 600+ capacity performance space, world-class sound and lighting systems, and a diverse F&B proposition. More than just a venue, it’s a hub for creativity, culture and collaboration.

name: Pothole Plotters!
description:
Every Bengalurean has a pothole they know personally, the one they swerve around without even thinking. Tired of complaining about potholes? Come, let’s make some art out of that angst!

We’ll walk around the streets of Indiranagar, take a closer look at these potholes and study their personalities. Some are loners and some come in gangs, some have become muscle memory and others shake up your entire world! We’ll map some of their parameters and turn each pothole into data art.

Paper Crane Lab’s pen plotter Sitalakshmi will then plot your pothole onto a postcard. Keep it for yourself, or mail it to your officials asking them to take notice!

Join Radz Subbu and Aditi Bhat in this workshop where you’ll learn about data art and pen plotters, and create civic commentary!

name: Meghalaya Fire & Feast- Bengaluru
description:
MEGHALAYA: MEAT. BBQ. ROCK & ROLL. TRIBAL CUISINE.

The LARGEST CONGREGATION of the meat masters of the country. Slow cooked meats over open fire - think whole hogs, assado grills and generations old smoking techniques brought to your city for one evening.

Meghalaya Fire & Feast rolls into town with a heavyweight line-up: BBQ legends, pitmasters and chefs from Meghalaya’s Khasi, Garo and Jaintia tribes, bringing smoked meats, glowing coals and a serious love for smoked meat.

On the grills: low-and-slow barbecue, meat over open flames and tribal recipes handed down through generations. These chefs have put in the hours. Come taste why they belong on this bill.

Cold beer pouring. Cocktails shaking. Motorcycles gleaming. Live bands tearing up the stage and DJs with unusual tastes and questionable respect for genre boundaries. Music curated by Harley Rock Riders, with the volume where it belongs.

Come hungry. Get close to the fire. Make some noise.

BURN, BABY, BURN.

name: An Hour of Stillness - An immersive sound experience
description:
Somewhere between the demands of the day and the things waiting for tomorrow, there is a little space to pause.

Join Sri for an immersive 60-minute sound experience with Himalayan singing bowls, crystal bowls, handpan, ocean drum and gong.

Through layers of sound, moments of quiet and a gentle return to the present, you'll have an hour to simply listen.

There's nothing to learn, no experience required and nothing you need to achieve.

Just come as you are. Get comfortable. Listen.

**What to expect**

- A gentle arrival and grounding
- An immersive journey through live instrumental sounds
- Moments of quiet and stillness
- Time to return slowly before the session closes

**Who is this for?**

Anyone looking to step away from the demands of everyday life and make a little room for themselves. No prior meditation or sound experience is needed.

name: 7Paintings - The Art of Dining
description:
• 7 Paintings is a globally acclaimed German dining concept, making its debut in India for the first time in Bengaluru.

• An immersive dining experience that brings together art, technology, storytelling and fine dining in a unique, interactive format.

• Guests embark on a 2.5-hour journey featuring a seven-course dinner, with each course inspired by iconic masterpieces brought to life through mesmerising projections on the dining table.

• Located at Gladia Brewery & Kitchen on Sarjapur Main Road, the experience is strictly by advance reservation only, with no walk-ins permitted.

name: Table92 - Supper Club
description:
Table 92 is an intimate home-dining experience where food becomes a reason to slow down, connect, and have conversations.

Hosted in a cozy home in Koramangala, Bangalore, each gathering welcomes just six guests for a thoughtfully curated two-hour experience. Over a five-course meal, you’ll share stories, perspectives, laughter, and perhaps leave with a few new friends.

We host both brunch and supper editions across the month, each with a different menu and mood.

What’s Included

• A curated 5-course meal

• A two-hour intimate dining experience

• Intimate group of only 6-8 guests

• Shared dining and conversation experience

• Vegetarian and non-vegetarian options available

Good to Know

• Exact venue details will be shared after booking.

• Please inform us of any dietary restrictions in advance.

• Instagram: @table92

Come hungry. Leave with stories.

name: Potato Head Bali X Brine
description:
Bali docks at Brine for one night.

The bar: Akbar, who runs beverage R&D at Potato Head, takes over our bar. He works root-to-flower, wasting nothing, and he's bringing four drinks from Bali: Barong Zombie, Papa Paan, Kookaburra and Asinan Margarita.

The decks: Dita of Klymax Discotheque plays proto-house, 90s breaks, Balearic and beyond. She's played Dekmantel, Panorama Bar and Boiler Room, and on the 28th she plays Brine.

The Kitchen: A special limited menu for the night: karaage, burgers, char siu rice, and noodles

Cruise over for a good one!
